messages.subject: dartR v2
parts:
Dear all,

Finally, the second version of dartR is on CRAN; you can install it by typing:
> install.packages("dartR")

We have submitted a paper announcing its release on Methods in Ecology and Evolution; it will take some time to get published. In the meantime, we have a preprint in bioRxiv: https://doi.org/10.1101/2022.03.30.486475

Regards,
Luis
